summary: @Cynthinee Majority of my students didn't want to work in open. They begged to have all my classes in the LMS. When you have 2-3 jobs, a kid or two, and been traumatized by inequity in k12 learning, ease of use can trump #OpenPedagogy #OpenEd19
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @Cynthinee Majority of my students didn't want to work in open. They begged to have all my classes in the LMS. When you have 2-3 jobs, a kid or two, and been traumatized by inequity in k12 learning, ease of use can trump #OpenPedagogy #OpenEd19
